findings.title: Global unsubscribe text now requires a per-topic unsubscribe_url from every caller
findings.body: The global `unsubscribe_link` string now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but only `UserNotifications#send_notification_email` was updated to pass `unsubscribe_url`. Any other `Email::MessageBuilder` caller that sets `add_unsubscribe_link: true` will render this locale string via `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` without `unsubscribe_url` and raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument`, breaking those emails. Either supply `unsubscribe_url` everywhere, provide a default in `MessageBuilder`, or make the per-topic sentence conditional.

findings.title: unsubscribe can 500 when no TopicUser record exists
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` returns nil when the logged-in user has no topic_user row for that topic. The next line calls `tu.notification_level`, raising `NoMethodError` and returning a 500. The route is reachable by any logged-in user for a visible topic and can also be hit from email links in edge cases. Use `TopicUser.get` or `TopicUser.change`, which creates the missing row instead of assuming it exists.

findings.title: Per-topic unsubscribe downgrades watching/tracking to regular instead of muting
findings.body: For a user with tracking or watching level, `notification_level > regular`, so the action sets the level to `regular`. Regular still generates notifications and emails for replies, quotes, and mentions in that topic, so the email's promise to "stop receiving notifications about this particular topic" is not honored for those users. If the intent is to stop all topic notifications, set `muted`; otherwise the email copy and route behavior are contradictory.

findings.title: New per-topic unsubscribe URL is not asserted
findings.body: The test now passes `unsubscribe_url: "/t/1234/unsubscribe"`, but the assertion still only checks that the old `user_preferences_url` appears in the body. There is no test that the rendered text/HTML contains the per-topic unsubscribe URL, nor coverage for the now-required interpolation argument when `add_unsubscribe_link` is true. This allows the new contract introduced by the locale change to regress without failing specs.
